reference: Look! The assistant is holding the reflector up now.
sk: Pozri! Asistent práve drží odrazovú dosku hore.
cz: Podívej! Asistent právě drží odraznou desku nahoře.
acceptable: Look! The assistant is holding {up the reflector|the reflector up|up the reflector board|the reflector board up}{ now| right now|}.
Look! {Now|Right now} the assistant is holding {up the reflector|the reflector up|up the reflector board|the reflector board up}.

mistakes.text: Look! The assistant holds the reflector up now.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Deje sa to teraz, patrí tu Present Continuous: „is holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děje se to teď, patří sem Present Continuous: „is holding“.

mistakes.text: Look! The assistant holding the reflector up{ now|}.
Look! The assistant is hold the reflector up{ now|}.
Look! Assistant is holding the reflector up{ now|}.
Look! The assistant is holding the reflector upstairs{ now|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „upstairs“ znamená „na poschodí“, hore v ruke je „up“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „upstairs“ znamená „v patře“, nahoře v ruce je „up“.
